extraction_notes: Filing is generic IT-services 10-K. CRITICAL OBSERVATION: filing names ZERO Pentagon Program Elements (no PE numbers), ZERO named DoD programs (other than the already-terminated AAV from 2018), and ZERO named multi-year programs of record. Revenue is disclosed only by service branch (Army 15%, Navy 12%, Other DoD 21%, Other federal 50%). This is the OPPOSITE of the J-Book Exposure Divergence pattern — SAIC cannot be caught by pentagon_jbook because it discloses nothing the J-Book can be queried against. The 1,900-contract portfolio is too diffuse to map. Forward narrative is generic ('broadband, cyber, climate resiliency'). This is itself a finding: the framework SHOULD return mostly UNVERIFIABLE here, which is the correct answer for diffuse IT-integrator filings.
